title: 第25章 只跪天地不跪众生第26章 一个宗门总有一两个傻逼草了
slug: 被问罪当天无上帝族杀来
content_zh:
与此同时，山门前的众弟子，也被徐徐降落的灵舟吸引住了目光。
正在他们猜测是哪位大人物登临圣地时，圣地突然动荡了起来。
只见，一道道身影从圣地深处冲出，朝山门所在掠来。
这什么情况，圣主他们怎么都出来了？
看着眼前这一道道熟悉又陌生的身影。
现场众弟子的脸上全是震骇之色。
“这事本少知道个一二。”
这时，一位双手抱剑，神态孤傲的男子，淡淡开口道。
“怎么说？”
众人皆是看向楚长歌。
楚长歌出身不凡，这并不是什么秘密了。
所以，在圣地也没几个人敢得罪他的。
但也不得不承认，这人有着他们没有的信息来源。
“这灵舟是界域殿的，我曾跟族里的长辈去那里做过客。”
说到这，楚长歌嘴角扯着一抹淡淡的桀骜，“当时界护殿的殿主，就是用这灵舟接送着我们。”
靠，这狗东西，又装起来了。
众人真是看不过眼楚长歌的嘴脸啊。
“我听族里的长辈说，我们圣主已经不止一次邀请姜殿主过来当个荣誉圣主了。”
“哦，差点忘记跟你们说了，界护殿的殿主姓姜。”
呵呵。

你很懂是吧。
众人扯着僵硬的笑容，应对着楚长歌的装逼。
楚长歌很满意众人的反应，于是继续道，“如果我猜得不错，姜殿主应该是答应我们圣主的请求了。”
“所以，举宗出来相迎，也就不是什么怪事了。”
原来如此。
我就说嘛。
怎么圣主他们会齐驾相迎呢。
众人纷纷反应了过来，神态也跟着肃然起来。
下界蛮夷，终究是蛮夷，界护殿算什么，不过是看门的罢了。
真正强大的势力，还得是上界那些原始种族。
楚长歌摇了摇头，眼中全是鄙夷。
对于楚长歌等人的想法，那些圣主长老自然是不知道。
此时，他们正神态肃然，微微躬着身体恭迎着。
尤其是圣主姬幽月，她可是接收到了姜太初的传音。
说上界隐世族势力公子驾临，要在他们这里历练。
当听到这个消息时，她吓得连忙从棺材里跳了起来，连潜修都不敢继续了。
堂堂隐世势力的公子，来她们这种小势力历练，这不是闹吗。
content_en:
At the same time, the disciples in front of the mountain gate were also attracted by the slowly landing spirit boat.
While they were guessing which big shot was coming to the Holy Land, the Holy Land suddenly became turbulent.
I saw figures rushing out from the depths of the Holy Land and heading towards the mountain gate.
What's going on? Why did the Holy Lord and the others come out?
Looking at the familiar and unfamiliar figures in front of me.
The faces of all the disciples present were filled with shock.
"I don't know much about this."
At this time, a man with a sword in both hands and an arrogant expression spoke calmly.
"How to say?"
Everyone looked at Chu Changge.
It is no secret that Chu Changge has an extraordinary background.
Therefore, few people in the Holy Land dare to offend him.
But they have to admit that this person has a source of information that they don't have.
"This spirit boat belongs to the Realm Palace. I once visited there as a guest with the elders of the clan."
Speaking of this, Chu Changge said with a touch of unruliness at the corner of his mouth, "The master of the Jiehu Palace at that time used this spirit boat to pick us up."
Damn, this bitch is pretending again.
Everyone really couldn't stand Chu Changge's face.
"I heard from the elders in the clan that our Holy Master has invited Palace Master Jiang to come over and be an honorary Holy Master more than once."
"Oh, I almost forgot to tell you that the master of Jiehu Palace's surname is Jiang."
Haha.
You understand very well, right?
Everyone smiled stiffly in response to Chu Changge's pretense.
Chu Changge was very satisfied with everyone's reaction, so he continued, "If my guess is correct, Palace Master Jiang should have agreed to our Holy Master's request."
"So, it's not strange for the entire clan to come out to greet you."
That’s it.
I'll just say it.
Why would the Holy Lord and the others come together to welcome him?
Everyone reacted one after another, and their expressions became solemn.
The barbarians in the lower realm are still barbarians after all, and the Jiehu Palace is nothing but a gatekeeper.
The truly powerful forces must be those primitive races in the upper world.
Chu Changge shook his head, his eyes filled with contempt.
Naturally, the Holy Lord elders did not know what Chu Changge and others thought.
At this time, they were greeting him with solemn expressions and slightly bowed bodies.
Especially Holy Lord Ji Youyue, she received Jiang Taichu's message.
It is said that the masters of the hidden world clan in the upper world are coming and want to practice with them.
When she heard the news, she was so frightened that she jumped out of the coffin and even Qian Xiu did not dare to continue.
Isn't it ridiculous that a noble son from a hidden power comes to a small power like them to gain experience?
